description: Find upcoming Iași events from the avizier (events board) — concerts, theater, film, sport, festivals, family, culture, comedy. Filter by date or date range, category, free entry, featured headliners, max price (RON), or free text. Defaults to upcoming and ongoing events sorted chronologically. `data.truncated` says when the list was cut and `data.matched` counts every match — raise `limit` to list them all.
name: find_events
